evals.name: recurring-red-pipeline
evals.prompt: Mon workflow GitHub Actions plante une fois sur trois et je relance jusqu'à ce que ça passe. Analyse les erreurs et dis-moi comment les éviter pour de bon, pas avec un contournement.
evals.expected_output: Run history summarised and ranked by wasted minutes, failures classified into root-cause categories with log evidence, quick fixes explicitly rejected, concrete permanent fixes with prevention, and owners/effort.
expectations: Run history is collected (gh run list or provided data) and ranked by time wasted by failures
Each failure class is tied to evidence from a log or run
Flaky behaviour (passes on retry, same commit passes and fails) is distinguished from environment drift and from regressions
Re-running until green, continue-on-error, added sleeps and raised timeouts are rejected as fixes
Each permanent fix is concrete (file, key, value) and states its cost
A prevention step is proposed (workflow linting, pinned versions or required check)

evals.name: pasted-permission-error
evals.prompt: Ma CI vient d'échouer avec ça : 'Resource not accessible by integration' sur l'étape qui poste un commentaire sur la PR. Je mets permissions: write-all et c'est réglé non ?
evals.expected_output: The assistant explains why write-all is a workaround, identifies the one permission the step needs, scopes it to the job, and notes the fork-PR limitation.
expectations: write-all is not recommended; the specific permission needed (for example pull-requests: write) is named
The permission is scoped to the job that needs it, with the rest read-only
The fork pull request case (read-only token, no secrets) is mentioned
The pasted error is classified as a permissions/token problem
